name: VeoVideo
title: Veo Video
description: Generate short videos with Google Veo, from a prompt, a first frame and a last frame
whenToUse: Turn still images and a description into a short video with sound, four to eight seconds. Give it the frame to open on and, optionally, the frame to end on, and it animates the transition between them; up to three reference images keep a character or product looking the same. A still image, and a live spoken conversation, are different jobs.

inputs.name: signal
inputs.description: Data from previous nodes, referenceable in the prompt and image urls

outputs.name: video
outputs.description: The finished video: dataUri, mimeType, fileName, bytes

model.title: Model
model.description: Which Veo model to render with

prompt.title: Motion Prompt
prompt.description: What happens in the video, the motion, camera, mood and sound.

firstFrameUrl.title: First Frame URL
firstFrameUrl.description: The image the video opens on. Leave empty to generate from the prompt alone.

lastFrameUrl.title: Last Frame URL
lastFrameUrl.description: The image the video ends on. Needs a first frame. Leave empty to let Veo decide.

referenceImageUrls.title: Reference Image URLs
referenceImageUrls.description: Up to three images, one URL per line, of a character or product to keep looking the same. Using any forces an 8 second video.

authRequired.title: Require sign-in
authRequired.description: Only a signed-in caller may run this step. Leave off and it runs for whoever the workflow's trigger admitted, which is the usual answer.

authRole.title: Require role
authRole.description: A claim the caller's account must carry, as noun:verb (finance:approve, payments:refund). Leave blank to require only that they are signed in.

package.name: gce-toolkit
package.packageFile:
# GEMINI IMAGE GENERATION AS A MANIFEST. Needed nothing new: an api-key header, a JSON POST,
# and `transport: binary` for the optional reference photo, which S3Upload had already forced.
#
# TWO THINGS CHANGED, both recorded on the node itself:
#
#   the instruction text  The retired service held two long instruction strings inline. They
#                         are prompt BLOCKS now, because a node holding a copy of words that
#                         also live in a block is a copy that drifts.
#   generateContent       The retired service used the SDK's generateContentStream and
#                         accumulated the chunks. This asks the non-streaming endpoint for the
#                         same thing, so the node still settles once and stays a PromiseNode.
#
# The retired TypeScript is at `_legacy/nodes/gce-toolkit/`.

name: gce-toolkit
displayName: Google Gemini
description: Generate images with Google Gemini and videos with Google Veo
version: 2.1.0
category: media
logoUrl: https://res.cloudinary.com/sonik/image/upload/v1768126954/gravity/icons/gemini.png

features:
  - Text to image, several images per request
  - An optional reference photo, used for facial likeness only
  - The model's own text response alongside the images
  - Short videos with sound from Veo, from a first frame, a last frame and reference images

allowedHosts:
  - generativelanguage.googleapis.com
  # Any host, for the UNAUTHENTICATED image fetches only (reference photo, video frames). The url is one a person
  # supplies, so it cannot be declared in advance. That call sends no credential, and the
  # executor refuses "*" the moment one does.
  - "*"

requires:
  credential: [apiKeyHeader]
  transport: [json, binary]
  executorVersion: ">=1.6.0"
  # The video node waits on a render. Without `poll` it would settle on the operation RECEIPT
  # and emit that as the answer, with nothing anywhere reporting a problem.
  poll: true

credentials.geminiCredential.yaml:
# Transcribed from the retired GeminiCredential, NAME AND FIELD UNCHANGED so credentials
# already stored against `geminiCredential` keep resolving.

name: geminiCredential
displayName: Google Gemini
description: Credentials for the Google Gemini API
documentationUrl: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/api-key

properties:
  - name: apiKey
    displayName: API Key
    type: string
    required: true
    secret: true
    description: Your Google Gemini API key
    placeholder: AIza...

files.api/events.yaml:
# One row per output connector, in interface.yaml order.

- emit: video
  from: response
  value: >-
    return {
      dataUri: 'data:' + ((calls.download || {}).contentType || 'video/mp4') + ';base64,' + ((calls.download || {}).base64 || ''),
      mimeType: (calls.download || {}).contentType || 'video/mp4',
      fileName: 'veo_video.mp4',
      bytes: (calls.download || {}).bytes || 0
    }

# `generatedAt` is epoch milliseconds: the sandbox exposes Date.now() and refuses `new`.
- emit: metadata
  from: response
  value: >-
    return {
      model: config.model,
      durationSeconds: (config.referenceImageUrls || config.resolution === '1080p' || config.resolution === '4k')
        ? 8
        : Number(config.durationSeconds || 8),
      generatedAt: Date.now()
    }
files.api/run.yaml:
# Fetch the frames (when given), start the render, poll until done, download the file.
#
# The image fetches carry NO credential, which is why "*" is allowed for them in the package:
# the urls are ones a person supplies. Unlike the image node's reference photo they ARE fatal
# when they fail, because a video told to open on a frame it never received is not the video
# that was asked for.

- name: first
  when: "return !!String(config.firstFrameUrl || '').trim()"
  method: GET
  url: "return String(config.firstFrameUrl).trim()"
  # { base64, contentType, bytes }. predictLongRunning takes images as
  # { bytesBase64Encoded, mimeType }, NOT the inlineData parts generateContent uses: Veo answers
  # 400 "inlineData isn't supported by this model" to the other shape (seen live 2026-09-29).
  transport: binary
  timeoutMs: 60000

- name: last
  when: "return !!String(config.lastFrameUrl || '').trim()"
  method: GET
  url: "return String(config.lastFrameUrl).trim()"
  transport: binary
  timeoutMs: 60000

# Up to three references, one url per line. Three named calls rather than a loop: the vendor
# caps it at three, so the ceiling is the API's, not a guess.
- name: ref1
  when: "return String(config.referenceImageUrls || '').split('\\n').map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean).length > 0"
  method: GET
  url: "return String(config.referenceImageUrls).split('\\n').map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean)[0]"
  transport: binary
  timeoutMs: 60000

- name: ref2
  when: "return String(config.referenceImageUrls || '').split('\\n').map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean).length > 1"
  method: GET
  url: "return String(config.referenceImageUrls).split('\\n').map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean)[1]"
  transport: binary
  timeoutMs: 60000

- name: ref3
  when: "return String(config.referenceImageUrls || '').split('\\n').map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean).length > 2"
  method: GET
  url: "return String(config.referenceImageUrls).split('\\n').map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean)[2]"
  transport: binary
  timeoutMs: 60000

# ONE RENDER, polled. The POST answers { name: "models/<model>/operations/<id>" }; GET on that
# name reports { done, response } and is what produces the video (ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/veo).
- name: generate
  method: POST
  url: >-
    return 'https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/'
      + config.model + ':predictLongRunning'
  credential:
    scheme: apiKeyHeader
    header: x-goog-api-key
    value: "{{ credentials.geminiCredential.apiKey }}"
  headers:
    Content-Type: application/json
  transport: json
  timeoutMs: 120000
  retry:
    attempts: 3
    backoff: exponential
    on: [429, 500, 502, 503, 504]

  body:
    instances: >-
      return [Object.assign(
        { prompt: String(config.prompt || '') },
        calls.first ? { image: { bytesBase64Encoded: calls.first.base64, mimeType: calls.first.contentType || 'image/png' } } : {},
        calls.last ? { lastFrame: { bytesBase64Encoded: calls.last.base64, mimeType: calls.last.contentType || 'image/png' } } : {},
        (calls.ref1 || calls.ref2 || calls.ref3)
          ? { referenceImages: [calls.ref1, calls.ref2, calls.ref3].filter(Boolean).map(r => ({
              image: { bytesBase64Encoded: r.base64, mimeType: r.contentType || 'image/png' },
              referenceType: 'asset'
            })) }
          : {}
      )]
    parameters: >-
      return {
        aspectRatio: config.aspectRatio || '16:9',
        resolution: config.resolution || '720p',
        // A NUMBER: the docs list "4" | "6" | "8" but the API answers 400 "needs to be a number"
        // to a string (seen live 2026-09-29).
        durationSeconds: (calls.ref1 || config.resolution === '1080p' || config.resolution === '4k')
          ? 8
          : Number(config.durationSeconds || 8)
      }

  # The reply is the FINAL operation payload, not the start receipt. 10s x 60 = ten minutes; a
  # render usually takes one to three, and a bound set for the fast job fails exactly the slow one.
  poll:
    url: "return 'https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/' + response.name"
    until: "return response.done === true"
    failed: "return !!response.error"
    message: "return 'Veo failed. ' + JSON.stringify(response.error || response)"
    intervalMs: 10000
    maxAttempts: 60

  # A render the safety filters removed finishes `done` with no sample and says why here.
  # `done` FIRST: `error` is also asked of the start receipt, which has no samples yet, and
  # without the guard every render failed on its own receipt (seen live 2026-09-29).
  error:
    when: >-
      return response.done === true
        && !((((response.response || {}).generateVideoResponse || {}).generatedSamples) || []).length
    message: >-
      return 'Veo returned no video. '
        + JSON.stringify(((response.response || {}).generateVideoResponse || {}).raiMediaFilteredReasons || response.response || response)

# The file. Veo's link needs the same API key, so nothing downstream could fetch it; the node
# downloads it and hands on the bytes.
- name: download
  method: GET
  url: >-
    return ((((calls.generate.response || {}).generateVideoResponse || {}).generatedSamples || [])[0] || {}).video.uri
  credential:
    scheme: apiKeyHeader
    header: x-goog-api-key
    value: "{{ credentials.geminiCredential.apiKey }}"
  transport: binary
  timeoutMs: 300000
files.config.yaml:
configSchema:
  type: object
  required: [model, prompt]
  properties:
    model:
      type: string
      title: Model
      description: Which Veo model to render with
      enum:
        - veo-3.1-generate-preview
        - veo-3.1-fast-generate-preview
        - veo-3.1-lite-generate-preview
      enumNames:
        - Veo 3.1, best quality
        - Veo 3.1 Fast, quicker and cheaper
        - Veo 3.1 Lite, fastest and cheapest
      default: veo-3.1-generate-preview
    prompt:
      type: string
      title: Motion Prompt
      description: What happens in the video, the motion, camera, mood and sound.
      default: ""
      "ui:field": template
      "ui:ai":
        editable: true
    firstFrameUrl:
      type: string
      title: First Frame URL
      description: The image the video opens on. Leave empty to generate from the prompt alone.
      default: ""
      "ui:field": template
    lastFrameUrl:
      type: string
      title: Last Frame URL
      description: The image the video ends on. Needs a first frame. Leave empty to let Veo decide.
      default: ""
      "ui:field": template
    referenceImageUrls:
      type: string
      title: Reference Image URLs
      description: >-
        Up to three images, one URL per line, of a character or product to keep looking the
        same. Using any forces an 8 second video.
      default: ""
      "ui:field": template
    durationSeconds:
      type: string
      title: Duration (seconds)
      description: 1080p, 4k and reference images all need 8.
      enum: ["4", "6", "8"]
      default: "8"
    aspectRatio:
      type: string
      title: Aspect Ratio
      enum: ["16:9", "9:16"]
      default: "16:9"
    resolution:
      type: string
      title: Resolution
      description: 720p is fastest; 1080p and 4k need 8 seconds.
      enum: [720p, 1080p, 4k]
      default: 720p
"ui:order": [model, prompt, firstFrameUrl, lastFrameUrl, referenceImageUrls, durationSeconds, aspectRatio, resolution]
files.interface.yaml:
inputs:
  - name: signal
    type: object
    description: Data from previous nodes, referenceable in the prompt and image urls
    required: false

outputs:
  # The file itself, as a data URI a storage step can take directly. Veo's own link needs the
  # API key to download, so it is useless to anything downstream and is not emitted.
  - name: video
    type: object
    description: "The finished video: dataUri, mimeType, fileName, bytes"
  - name: metadata
    type: object
    description: model, durationSeconds, generatedAt

credentials:
  - name: geminiCredential
    required: true
    displayName: Google Gemini API
files.node.yaml:
type: VeoVideo
# PromiseNode WITH `poll`: Veo renders as a long-running operation (the POST answers an
# operation name, GET on that name reports progress), then one more call downloads the file.
# The node's answer is still one settled reply, the finished video.
kind: PromiseNode

name: Veo Video
category: Media & Design
color: "#4285F4"

description: Generate short videos with Google Veo, from a prompt, a first frame and a last frame

whenToUse: >-
  Turn still images and a description into a short video with sound, four to eight seconds.
  Give it the frame to open on and, optionally, the frame to end on, and it animates the
  transition between them; up to three reference images keep a character or product looking
  the same. A still image, and a live spoken conversation, are different jobs.

# WHO MAY RUN THIS (who-can-run-it.md). Compulsory on every node.
auth:
  required: false

capabilities:
  # NOT cacheable: generation is non-deterministic, two runs are meant to differ.
  cacheable: false
files.test.yaml:
# Text-to-video, short and at the lowest resolution: the cheapest honest render (Veo bills per
# second). Asserts the SHAPE: real video bytes came back, never anything about the scene.

testData:
  config:
    model: veo-3.1-lite-generate-preview
    prompt: >-
      A paper boat drifting across a puddle in light rain, gentle ripples, soft ambient
      sound, slow push-in
    firstFrameUrl: ""
    lastFrameUrl: ""
    referenceImageUrls: ""
    durationSeconds: "4"
    aspectRatio: "16:9"
    resolution: 720p
  inputs:
    signal: {}
  expect:
    video: >-
      return output.video.dataUri.startsWith('data:video/')
        && output.video.bytes > 10000
    metadata: "return output.metadata.generatedAt > 0"
